display_information.name: CoreWeave Usage Bot
display_information.description: Storage-usage digest and staged-deletion review for the Marin CoreWeave buckets — cw.oa.dev
display_information.long_description:
Posts a daily storage-usage thread for the Marin CoreWeave buckets, and staged-deletion reviews for admins. Dashboard: https://cw.oa.dev

Each pool's mark answers two questions.

Color: how soon will it fill? Days until full at its current pace, from deep green (60 days or more, or not filling) to red (under 2 days, or at or over quota). A pool at least 95% full never shows better than orange.

Arrow: how fast is it moving? Its growth rate as a share of what it holds, the fastest of the last 1, 3 and 7 days. It points down only if the pool shrank over all three.
